Manifesting never worked for me and I felt genuinely crap about it. Watched everyone else talk about it like it was second nature while I just sat there feeling broken. Took Elara Vance arche type quiz purely out of desperation, honestly didn't expect anything. Matched me exactly. Like, uncomfortably exact. Didn't see that coming at all. If you've been beating yourself up over this too, just try it. Costs you two minutes. ❤️
So soothing and Calming, felt so refreshing after this 15 min meditation

I feel like I struggled most of my life with how to manifest. Sometimes it felt so out of reach that I decided to give that arche type quiz by Amara Lorne a try, and it really did wonders. It matched my personal arche type exactly, and that’s how I finally figured out how to do it properly. I highly recommend anyone who struggled like me to try it as well! It only takes a couple of minutes anyway ❤️
